data.name: Intro
data.value: The following development tools work with the DDI Registry.

data.name: ResolverDotNet
data.value: The Colectica DDI Resolver Library for .NET can be used by .NET software developers to use the global Domain Name System (DNS) to query for information about DDI agencies.

data.name: ResolverJava
data.value: The Colectica DDI Resolver Library for Java can be used by Java software developers to use the global Domain Name System (DNS) to query for information about DDI agencies.

data.name: RegistrySourceDesc
data.value: You can deploy the DDI Registry software on your own infrastructure to run your own registry service. You might want to do this if you would like to provide your own delegation and resolution services, instead of relying on the DDI Alliance's registry service.
